# Environment Setup

## Install and Load Libraries

```r
install.packages("pak") # https://github.com/r-lib/pak

pak::pak(
  c(
    "tidyverse",   # https://github.com/tidyverse/tidyverse/
    "sf",          # https://github.com/r-spatial/sf/
    "openrouteservice", # https://github.com/GIScience/openrouteservice-r/
    # "DBI",         # https://github.com/r-dbi/DBI/
    # "duckdb",      # https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb-r/
    # "duckplyr",    # https://github.com/tidyverse/duckplyr/
    # "duckspatial", # https://github.com/Cidree/duckspatial/
```

## Project Configurations

### Setup OpenRouteService API

```{r}
#| label: setup-ors

# Ensure your _environment file has: ORS_API_KEY="your_key_here"
readRenviron(here::here("_environment"))

# 2. Check Key
if (Sys.getenv("ORS_API_KEY") == "") {
  stop("❌ ORS_API_KEY not found in _environment file.")
} else {
  # Set it for the package
  ors_api_key(Sys.getenv("ORS_API_KEY"))
  message("✅ API Key Loaded")
}
```

### Database Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup-db-init

# Initialize In-memory database
conn <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())

# install and load spatial extension
DBI::dbExecute(conn, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")
DBI::dbExecute(conn, "CALL register_geoarrow_extension()")
```

### Path Configuration

```{r}
#| label: setup-dirs

# Setup Paths & Params
dirs <- list(
  source = here::here("_src"), # Source custom functions
  raw = here::here("_data/raw"), # Input: Shapefiles, GDBs, CSVs
  processed = here::here("_data/processed"), # Intermediate Output: Standardized Parquets
  buffered = here::here("_data/buffered"), # Intermediate Output: Buffered layers
  isochrones = here::here("_data/isochrones"), # Intermediate Output: ORS Isochrones
  results = here::here("_output") # Final Output: Analysis Results
)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-subdirs

# Define Sub-directories (To match your existing structure)
sub_dirs <- list(
  base   = here::here(dirs$processed, "base_layers"),
  parcels = here::here(dirs$processed, "parcels_taz"),
  landuse = here::here(dirs$processed, "landuse_zones"),
  transport = here::here(dirs$processed, "transportation"),
  access = here::here(dirs$processed, "access"),
  amenities = here::here(dirs$processed, "amenities")
)
```

### Projection Constants

```{r}
#| label: setup-crs

# Projection Constants
CRS_PROJ <- "EPSG:3566" # NAD83 / Utah Central (Projected - ftUS)
CRS_VIEW <- "EPSG:3857" # WGS 84 / Pseudo-Mercator (Projected - Meters)
CRS_WGS  <- "EPSG:4326" # WGS84 (Geographic - Lat/Lon)
```

## Helper Functions

```{r}
#| label: load-helpers

source(here::here(dirs$source, "download_feature_layer.R")) # Download ArcGIS Feature Layers
source(here::here(dirs$source, "process_local_layer.R")) # Load local SHP, GDB, GeoJSON Layers
source(here::here(dirs$source, "preview_layer.R")) # Preview (geo)parquet files using mapgl
```

# Process Isochrones

## Set Isochrone Inputs and Configuration

```{r}
#| label: isochrone-setup

# We use the parquet files created in step 1
input_layers <- c(
  file.path(sub_dirs$transport, "UTA_Stops_and_Most_Recent_Ridership.parquet"), # Transit (All Modes)
  file.path(sub_dirs$amenities, "Community_Centers.parquet"),
  file.path(sub_dirs$amenities, "ChildCareFacilities.parquet"),
  file.path(sub_dirs$amenities, "UtahGroceryAndFoodStores_DAF.parquet"),
  file.path(sub_dirs$amenities, "LicensedHealthCareFacilities.parquet"),
  file.path(sub_dirs$amenities, "Schools_PreKto12.parquet"),
  file.path(sub_dirs$amenities, "Schools_HigherEducation.parquet")
)
```

```{r}
#| label: isochrone-batch-helper

# Batch Helper Function
# Takes a list of files -> Generates Isochrones using original filenames
run_batch <- function(file_list, profile, range, ...) {

  purrr::walk(file_list, function(input_path) {

    # 1. Get original name (e.g. "ChildCareFacilities")
    original_name <- fs::path_ext_remove(fs::path_file(input_path))

    # 2. Execute
    # process_isochrones automatically handles the subfolder creation based on 'profile'
    process_isochrones(
      path        = input_path,
      name        = original_name,  # Output name matches input name
      profile     = profile,
      range       = range,
      save_dir    = dirs$isochrones,
      dry_run     = FALSE,          # Set to TRUE to test
      batch_size  = 5,
      ...                           # Pass extra args
    )
  })
}
```

## Generate Walking Isochrones

```{r}
#| label: isochrone-walking

run_batch(
  file_list = target_layers,
  profile   = "foot-walking",
  range     = c(300, 600, 900)
)
```

## Generate Biking Isochrones

```{r}
#| label: isochrone-biking

run_batch(
  file_list = target_layers,
  profile   = "cycling-regular",
  range     = c(300, 600, 900)
)
```

## Generate Driving Isochrones

```{r}
#| label: isochrone-driving

run_batch(
  file_list = target_layers,
  profile   = "driving-car",
  range     = c(300, 600, 900)
)
```

